bindings.note: Quiet selections are reusable project recipes, not a claim that every MD3 component shares these timings. Components using spring schemes use the matching physical role.

webApproximation.emphasized: Normalized exact two-segment path data is portable. CSS linear() uses1025 uniformly spaced samples plus the exact join. CSS browsers without linear() use standard cubic as an explicitly approximate fallback.
webApproximation.springs: Unit mass and zero initial velocity. Derived finite durations use conservative underdamped displacement/speed envelopes <=.001, or the critical response after its speed maximum. Equal-time samples at >=60Hz end at exactly1. These durations are not additional MD3 duration slots; native settling and velocity interruption may differ.
webApproximation.reducedMotion: All generated duration variables, including derived spring duration variables, become0ms for OS or local reduced motion. Consumers must also stop ongoing animations and avoid autoplay.
